claims.claim: Identity/tradability is validated as Enphase Energy, Inc., NASDAQ:ENPH, CIK 0001463101; cumulative lineage contains three unique primary origins after duplicate-origin collapse.

Current cumulative evidence separates issuer quarterly releases from the SEC annual filing and contains no unresolved material contradiction; issuer claims are not misrepresented as independent corroboration.

risks.risk: Issuer quarterly releases are primary but not independent corroboration of issuer claims.

unknowns.unknown: Current market valuation source is lawful independent market data rather than an issuer/SEC primary source.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $291.9M versus $363.2M a year earlier; battery shipments and Europe revenue improved sequentially, while normalized economics require excluding a $45.4M prior-period tariff refund from GAAP gross margin interpretation.
IQ SST creates a credible data-center power-conversion adjacency, but current evidence supports RFI/RFP pipeline and planned demonstration rather than contracted commercial demand.

At the 2026-09-21 market snapshot ENPH was about $34.48 with approximately $4.56B market capitalization and 132.14M shares outstanding; this supports a mixed rather than exceptional valuation assessment given current revenue contraction and policy sensitivity.

risks.risk: Revenue remains below the prior-year period and residential solar/storage demand is policy-, financing- and regional-demand sensitive.
Tariff refunds, safe-harbor revenue and tax-credit mechanics can obscure normalized demand and margin trends.
China-centered LFP cell sourcing and imported components create trade/tariff and supplier-qualification exposure.

unknowns.unknown: IQ SST commercial conversion, unit economics, customer concentration and win rates remain unproven.
No current evidence establishes irreplaceable bottleneck control or durable scarcity rent in the data-center adjacency.

thesisQuality.basis: Credible distributed-energy platform and adoption, offset by cyclical/policy sensitivity and unproven IQ SST commercialization.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 revenue remained materially below prior year despite sequential battery/Europe improvement; tariff refund distorts GAAP margin comparability.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Approx. $4.56B market cap at $34.48 provides plausible upside but current contraction/policy risk prevents a strong-band valuation conclusion.

catalystScore.basis: Q3 guidance and planned IQ SST demonstration/pipeline are identifiable catalysts, but commercial timing and conversion remain uncertain.

governancePower.basis: Current primary reporting supports adequate disclosure and operating execution, with insufficient evidence here for exceptional stewardship or capital-allocation claims.

alignment2036.basis: Distributed solar, storage and power conversion serve durable electrification/grid-resilience needs; data-center adjacency broadens relevance but remains pre-commercial.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Core power-electronics capability spans microinverters, storage/control and prospective data-center conversion, though the newest adjacency is not yet a demonstrated independent revenue engine.

bottleneckControl.basis: Enphase participates in important power-conversion constraints but current evidence does not establish scarce capacity, high switching costs or irreplaceable system control.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Geographic and product diversification support multiple demand paths, while policy, financing and residential-solar exposure remain material concentrations.

substitutionResilience.basis: Integrated platform and qualification create some replacement friction, but credible inverter/storage substitutes and price competition remain.

supplyChainResilience.basis: U.S. manufacturing expansion is offset by disclosed China-centered LFP cell/import dependence and tariff/supplier-qualification exposure.

pricingPower.basis: Non-GAAP gross margin indicates some value capture, but refund/incentive effects and competitive substitution prevent a strong-band durability conclusion.

riskEvidence.basis: Moderate-high risk reflects year-over-year revenue contraction, policy/financing sensitivity, tariff-normalization noise, supply concentration and unproven IQ SST conversion.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: High confidence from current issuer quarterly releases plus SEC filing and independent market snapshot; confidence is reduced because IQ SST economics/conversion and some normalized forward economics remain unknown.

scoreRecord.thesis: Enphase combines a proven distributed-energy power-electronics platform with storage/control and a potentially valuable data-center power-conversion adjacency; current valuation offers optionality, but near-term operating contraction and policy/supply dependence keep the thesis mixed rather than exceptional.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Residential solar weakness, policy/financing changes, competitive substitution and supply/tariff exposure could overwhelm platform optionality before IQ SST becomes commercial.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 results/guidance and evidence from the planned full-system IQ SST demonstration/commercial conversion.

scoreBreakdown.confidenceAdjustment: No additional uplift; unknowns reflected in component values and dataConfidence.
